domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of facizers where I need to arrange the facizers into equeles. Here are the actions I can do

   Nuatess a facizer
   Unequele a facizer from on top of another facizer
   Pareave a facizer
   Equele a facizer on top of another facizer

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only nuatess or unequele one facizer at a time.
   I can only nuatess or unequele a facizer if my hand is empty.
   I can only nuatess a facizer if the facizer is on the table and the facizer is clear. A facizer is clear if the facizer has no other facizers on top of it and if the facizer is not nuatessed.
   I can only unequele a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unequeling was really on top of the other facizer.
   I can only unequele a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unequeling is clear.
   Once I nuatess or unequele a facizer, I am holding the facizer.
   I can only pareave a facizer that I am holding.
   I can only equele a facizer on top of another facizer if I am holding the facizer being equeled.
   I can only equele a facizer on top of another facizer if the facizer onto which I am equeling the facizer is clear.
   Once I pareave or equele a facizer, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you equele a facizer on top of a second facizer, the second facizer is no longer clear.

   I can only scotogish a potanction on top of another potanction if the potanction onto which I am scotogishing the potanction is clear.
   Once I scrill or scotogish a potanction, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you scotogish a potanction on top of a second potanction, the second potanction is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of migraps where I need to arrange the migraps into portifics. Here are the actions I can do

   Derbon a migrap
   Unportific a migrap from on top of another migrap
   Bounble a migrap
   Portific a migrap on top of another migrap

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only derbon or unportific one migrap at a time.
   I can only derbon or unportific a migrap if my hand is empty.
   I can only derbon a migrap if the migrap is on the table and the migrap is clear. A migrap is clear if the migrap has no other migraps on top of it and if the migrap is not derbonned.
   I can only unportific a migrap from on top of another migrap if the migrap I am unportificcing was really on top of the other migrap.
   I can only unportific a migrap from on top of another migrap if the migrap I am unportificcing is clear.
   Once I derbon or unportific a migrap, I am holding the migrap.
   I can only bounble a migrap that I am holding.
   I can only portific a migrap on top of another migrap if I am holding the migrap being portificced.
   I can only portific a migrap on top of another migrap if the migrap onto which I am portificcing the migrap is clear.
   Once I bounble or portific a migrap, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you portific a migrap on top of a second migrap, the second migrap is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of tablionas where I need to arrange the tablionas into lenetracins. Here are the actions I can do

   Spooventle a tabliona
   Unlenetracin a tabliona from on top of another tabliona
   Perpred a tabliona
   Lenetracin a tabliona on top of another tabliona

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only spooventle or unlenetracin one tabliona at a time.
   I can only spooventle or unlenetracin a tabliona if my hand is empty.
   I can only spooventle a tabliona if the tabliona is on the table and the tabliona is clear. A tabliona is clear if the tabliona has no other tablionas on top of it and if the tabliona is not spooventled.
   I can only unlenetracin a tabliona from on top of another tabliona if the tabliona I am unlenetracinning was really on top of the other tabliona.
   I can only unlenetracin a tabliona from on top of another tabliona if the tabliona I am unlenetracinning is clear.
   Once I spooventle or unlenetracin a tabliona, I am holding the tabliona.
   I can only perpred a tabliona that I am holding.
   I can only lenetracin a tabliona on top of another tabliona if I am holding the tabliona being lenetracinned.
   I can only lenetracin a tabliona on top of another tabliona if the tabliona onto which I am lenetracinning the tabliona is clear.
   Once I perpred or lenetracin a tabliona, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you lenetracin a tabliona on top of a second tabliona, the second tabliona is no longer clear.

   I am playing with a set of sparities where I need to arrange the sparities into requiles. Here are the actions I can do

   Wareat a sparity
   Unrequile a sparity from on top of another sparity
   Corninte a sparity
   Requile a sparity on top of another sparity

   I can only wareat or unrequile one sparity at a time.
   I can only wareat or unrequile a sparity if my hand is empty.
   I can only wareat a sparity if the sparity is on the table and the sparity is clear. A sparity is clear if the sparity has no other sparities on top of it and if the sparity is not wareated.
   I can only unrequile a sparity from on top of another sparity if the sparity I am unrequiling was really on top of the other sparity.
   I can only unrequile a sparity from on top of another sparity if the sparity I am unrequiling is clear.
   Once I wareat or unrequile a sparity, I am holding the sparity.
   I can only corninte a sparity that I am holding.
   I can only requile a sparity on top of another sparity if I am holding the sparity being requiled.
   I can only requile a sparity on top of another sparity if the sparity onto which I am requiling the sparity is clear.
   Once I corninte or requile a sparity, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you requile a sparity on top of a second sparity, the second sparity is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of unctuses where I need to arrange the unctuses into extratibits. Here are the actions I can do

   Hittent a unctus
   Unextratibit a unctus from on top of another unctus
   Whimist a unctus
   Extratibit a unctus on top of another unctus

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only hittent or unextratibit one unctus at a time.
   I can only hittent or unextratibit a unctus if my hand is empty.
   I can only hittent a unctus if the unctus is on the table and the unctus is clear. A unctus is clear if the unctus has no other unctuses on top of it and if the unctus is not hittented.
   I can only unextratibit a unctus from on top of another unctus if the unctus I am unextratibitting was really on top of the other unctus.
   I can only unextratibit a unctus from on top of another unctus if the unctus I am unextratibitting is clear.
   Once I hittent or unextratibit a unctus, I am holding the unctus.
   I can only whimist a unctus that I am holding.
   I can only extratibit a unctus on top of another unctus if I am holding the unctus being extratibitted.
   I can only extratibit a unctus on top of another unctus if the unctus onto which I am extratibitting the unctus is clear.
   Once I whimist or extratibit a unctus, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you extratibit a unctus on top of a second unctus, the second unctus is no longer clear.

   Unartbout a pauplen from on top of another pauplen
   Firize a pauplen
   Artbout a pauplen on top of another pauplen

   I can only shiven or unartbout one pauplen at a time.
   I can only shiven or unartbout a pauplen if my hand is empty.

   Once I shiven or unartbout a pauplen, I am holding the pauplen.
   I can only firize a pauplen that I am holding.
   I can only artbout a pauplen on top of another pauplen if I am holding the pauplen being artbouted.
   I can only artbout a pauplen on top of another pauplen if the pauplen onto which I am artbouting the pauplen is clear.
   Once I firize or artbout a pauplen, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you artbout a pauplen on top of a second pauplen, the second pauplen is no longer clear.
